dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Rays Outlast Rangers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**

In a tightly contested matchup, Yandy Díaz and Cedric Mullins led the Tampa Bay Rays to a 3-2 win over the Texas Rangers. Mullins' 13th home run of the season proved to be the difference-maker, a fly ball to left field that helped propel the Rays to victory. Jonny DeLuca also had a strong outing, going 2-for-4 with a home run and an RBI. On the mound, Steven Matz was sharp, striking out three batters over two scoreless innings.

Meanwhile, in other games, Kody Clemens hit a grand slam for the Minnesota Twins, and Daniel Susac homered twice for the San Francisco Giants. Robbie Ray also threw a complete game for the Giants, shutting out the San Diego Padres 4-1.
